_scope: The GET /config form's sdm_conversion select (3 options), in form order. Raw name -> row text and closed-dropdown title. Flat: no family, no variant, no grouping — three options do not need headers, and the renderer puts an entry without a `family` at the top level. `leaf` is the row text, taken from the manual's own option wording with the trailing period dropped; `short` is the closed title, trimmed to the part that distinguishes the option. Short titles are unique across the list.
